$comment: Better Stack Telemetry sources for staging (spec 01 §8.2). Files name things: each source is fin-next-staging-<service>; IDs, tokens and ingest hosts are resolved at run time and never committed. dataRegion is the API's value for OB-02's Europe region. holders lists the Railway services whose sealed variables receive the source's ingest host and token (FIN_TELEMETRY_HOST, FIN_TELEMETRY_TOKEN); it defaults to the service itself. Neither the watcher (a Worker: watcher deploy reads its source's token and ingest host from Better Stack) nor pnpm fin (the ops source's token reaches it at the secure prompt) is a Railway service, so both have no holder. team, environment and namePrefix must be fin-<env>, <env> and fin-next-<env>- (MC-13).

sources.writes: connector.*, from all four cloudflared-* services (the service field tells them apart)
deploy.* and run.*, shipped by pnpm fin for its runs
